# RollCall

> Live college attendance portal for students and teachers.

## What is RollCall?

RollCall is a lightweight, self-hosted attendance management system built for colleges. Students can check their attendance percentage and teachers can mark roll call in seconds.

## Pages

- `/` — Landing page (public)
- `/student` — Student attendance dashboard (login required)
- `/teacher` — Teacher attendance dashboard (login required)
- `/admin` — Admin console (admin login required)

## Contact

For integration or API access, contact the college IT administrator.
